title: Hexagonal ceramic tiles with lattice colour patterns
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of hexagonal ceramic tiles on a periodic hex lattice, with grout, rounded and pillowed glaze, chipped edges and a colour rule (random accents, scattered flowers, alternating rows or clustered blends). Use for bathroom and kitchen walls, floors and terracotta paving.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python hexagon_tiles.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: columns
parameters.meaning: Hexagons across the tile width; the row count is the even number closest to a regular lattice.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: Colour rule on the lattice: 0 random mix with accents, 1 scattered flowers (an accent centre with six petals), 2 alternating rows, 3 clustered blend that drifts between the palette colours.

parameters.name: grout_width
parameters.meaning: Joint width in hexagon widths (across the flats).

parameters.name: grout_depth
parameters.meaning: How far the grout sits below the tile faces: 0 flush, 1 deep.

parameters.name: bevel
parameters.meaning: Width of the rounded tile edge in hexagon widths.

parameters.name: pillow
parameters.meaning: Dome of the glaze toward the tile centre, as handmade and cushion-edged tiles have.

parameters.name: glaze_waviness
parameters.meaning: Low ripples in the glaze surface that break up reflections.

parameters.name: chipping
parameters.meaning: Chipped tile edges that expose the clay body, 0 none to 1 heavily damaged.

parameters.name: accent_share
parameters.meaning: Share of accent tiles in the random mix, or how densely flowers are scattered.

parameters.name: colour_variation
parameters.meaning: Spread of tone between tiles of one colour.

parameters.name: dirt
parameters.meaning: Grime in the grout and along the tile edges.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: White glossy hexagon wall tiles with a few pale grey accents and light grout.

presets.name: black_white_flowers
presets.description: Small white hexagons with scattered flowers: six black petals around a grey centre.

presets.name: terracotta_pavers
presets.description: Large matte terracotta hexagon pavers with wide sandy joints and worn, chipped edges.

presets.name: mint_rows
presets.description: Glossy mint and white hexagons in alternating rows.

presets.name: ocean_blend
presets.description: Small blue and teal hexagons drifting between shades in clusters.

limits: A square tile holds an even number of hexagon rows, so hexagons are squashed or stretched by up to 4 percent for 5 columns and about 1 percent for 7, 12, 14 or 19 columns (15 percent for 3, 4 or 6). Glaze is opaque colour with a low roughness; there is no crazing, transparency or depth in the glaze. Flowers are dropped greedily in a seeded order, so their spacing is irregular. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Pointy-top hexagonal lattice in odd-row offset coordinates
Nearest hexagon centre from the two closest rows
Distance to the Voronoi cell border of a lattice from its bisectors
Axial hex coordinates for neighbours and flower placement
Fractional Brownian motion of tileable value and gradient noise
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
